Title: 3 Hidden Triggers Behind Heat Cramps (Not Just Tight Muscles)

Description:
Sudden leg or stomach cramps after a heavy sweat session? Heat cramps come from a mix of salt loss, fluid loss, and muscle fatigue - not just tight muscles. Being a heavy, salty sweater, drinking only plain water, and pushing through tired muscles all raise your risk.

Add electrolytes instead of relying on plain water alone, and when a cramp hits, stop, stretch, and massage the muscle in a cool spot.
